title: Memories That Outlive Their Reasons: Dependency-Tethered Memory for Tool-Using LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.25123v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Agents now act on the Web, publishing packages, models and datasets through registry APIs, and remembering past verifications spares them the work. But a verdict rests on premises. When a signing key is revoked, everything built on it stops passing, yet the advisory names only the key, and the old verdicts of its dependents may never share a retrieval window with it. This non-locality of invalidation turns memory into a liability: in long simulated chats, an agent reading a memory of atomic facts publishes 62% of the objects whose failure lies upstream, each backed by a record that was true when written. Yet derivation is local even when invalidation is not. Tether records, at write time, the exact versions each verdict derives from, and at read time withdraws any verdict whose support has failed anywhere in the store; the agent reads the same fields as before. translated_title: 超越其依据而存续的记忆：面向工具使用型LLM智能体的依赖锚定记忆
translated_abstract: 智能体如今在网络上行动，通过注册表API发布软件包、模型和数据集，而记住过去的验证结果可以为它们省去重复工作。但任何结论都建立在前提之上。当签名密钥被撤销时，构建于其上的一切都会失效，然而安全公告中只提及密钥本身，其依赖项的旧结论可能永远不会与该公告共享同一个检索窗口。这种失效的非局部性使记忆成为负担：在长时间的模拟对话中，一个读取原子事实记忆的智能体会发布其中62%的对象——这些对象的故障源于上游，而每一条支撑记录在写入时都是真实的。然而，即使失效不是局部的，推导却是局部的。Tether方法在写入时记录每个结论所源自的确切版本，并在读取时撤回存储中任何其支撑已失效的结论；智能体读取的字段与之前完全相同。在Fallout（一个带有假设盲模拟的版本化世界生成器）上……
tldr: 该论文提出依赖锚定记忆方法，通过在写入时记录每条结论所依赖的确切版本、在读取时自动撤回存储中任何支撑已失效的结论，解决了工具使用型LLM智能体因上游依赖失效而依赖过时记忆做出错误发布决策的问题。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes Dependency-Tethered Memory, which records the exact versions each verdict derives from at write time and withdraws any verdict whose support has failed at read time, solving the problem of tool-using LLM agents making faulty publication decisions based on stale memories when upstream dependencies fail.
